'''Masaki Aizawa''' ('''相沢まさき''' ''Aizawa Masaki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Aizawa was born on January 19, 1965 in {{wp|Hokkaido}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He began to provide voices for {{aniseries|PTS}} near the end of {{aniseries|GS}}, where his first role was [[Professor Telesu]]. His most prominent roles are two villainous team leaders: [[Archie]], the leader of [[Team Aqua]] from {{aniseries|RS}}; and [[Ghetsis]], the leader of [[Team Plasma]] from {{aniseries|BW}}. Later, in {{aniseries|SM}}, he played one of the four [[island kahuna]]s, [[Nanu]]. Aizawa is currently affiliated with OFFICE OSAWA.
